text: Graph e2e: give Playwright a way to locate WebGL nodes
description: e2e/graph-aim-drag-create.spec.ts (3 tests) fails because it queries `.graph-node`/`.graph-link` DOM elements that the WebGL renderer no longer creates. The SVG overlay's `.node-label-group` is not a substitute: labels are culled when `node.r * scale <= 20`, so small new nodes have no DOM. Needs a small test hook (e.g. data attributes on an always-rendered hit layer, or a window-exposed node screen-position lookup behind a dev flag) so tests can drag between nodes. Links can be asserted from persisted aims (sum of supportingConnections in <tmp>/.bowman/aims). Creating aims in graph view also opens a "Commit to Phase" prompt — use finishAimCreation from e2e/test-utils.ts. The removed multi-select bar test should assert `.aim-item.multi-selected` in the list view instead.

reflections.context: Tried to fix the 3 graph e2e tests without touching app code.
reflections.outcome: Two hook-free approaches failed. (1) `.graph-overlay .node-label-group` as node handle: labels are culled for small nodes (visibleLabelIds, r*scale<=20), so 0 elements. (2) Reusing double-click coordinates as node positions: aims are created at the click point (useGraphInteraction onDblClick sets pos=logicalMouse) and the file oracle confirmed them, but drags from those coordinates hit nothing — camera tracking (mapStore.isTracking) re-centers the view as nodes appear. Reverted; spec unchanged.
reflections.effectiveness: Partial: ruled out both cheap approaches; the file-based oracle (count aims / supportingConnections in <tmp>/.bowman/aims) and finishAimCreation for the Commit-to-Phase prompt do work.
reflections.lesson: Graph e2e needs an app-side hook: a dev-only (import.meta.env.DEV) window lookup that maps aim id/text to client coordinates via mapStore (cx = clientOffset+halfSide, s = visualScale, x = cx + s*(renderPos+offset)) plus the overlay's bounding rect.

status.comment: Dev-only node position hook + spec fixes committed; full chromium e2e 19/19 green, vitest 235/235.

reflection: Root causes were all test-side except the missing node handle: Playwright mouse.click ignores `modifiers`, drag-to-connect requires the node to be selected first, and graph creation chains Commit-to-Phase/Connection-details prompts.
